The Hospital-to-Home Care Checklist

What to ask, gather and write down before Mom leaves the hospital or rehab.

Download PDF

Mom is in the hospital or rehab, discharge is being discussed, and everyone is asking you what happens next. Before that conversation, make sure you have these in hand. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is something to ask for this week, not a verdict about Mom or about you.

Gather

Write down

Ask

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you gather, write down and ask. It doesn't tell you what care Mom needs, where she should go, what Medicare covers or what any of it costs. Those answers come from the people who assess her and the people who know her coverage. Nothing here is medical, legal, financial or tax advice.

Ready for the next step?

You've gathered, written down and asked. The care interview walks you through Mom's situation one area at a time, so what you've collected has somewhere to go, and turns your answers into a Family Care Profile you can bring to any care conversation.
